findings.title: Images must have alternative text on impact-mix.html
findings.plain: An image has no text alternative, so a person who cannot see it hears nothing about it from a screen reader, or only its file name.
findings.fix: Add an alt attribute that says what the image shows or what it is for. If it is only decoration, use alt="" so that screen readers skip it.

rule.help: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds

findings.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds on impact-mix.html
findings.plain: Text is too faint against its background for many people to read, people with low vision among them, and anyone looking at a screen in bright light.
findings.fix: Darken the text or lighten its background, or the other way round, until the contrast ratio is at least 4.5 to 1, or 3 to 1 for large text.

rule.help: Heading levels should only increase by one

findings.title: Heading levels should only increase by one on impact-mix.html
findings.plain: A heading skips a level, such as an h2 followed by an h4, so a person who reads the page's outline through its headings finds a gap in the outline.
findings.fix: Go down one level at a time: under an h2 comes an h3. To change how a heading looks, use CSS, not another level.

findings.title: Headings should not be empty on impact-mix.html
findings.plain: A heading has no text. A screen reader still announces it as a heading, so a person moving through the page by its headings lands on an empty one.
findings.fix: Give the heading text that names the section after it, or, if it is there only for its look, make it something other than a heading.
